Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Turn the Settings folder filter into a dropdown of real Penumbra sort-folders instead of free text, make the Settings window scroll when shrunk, and cache mod scans in memory instead of re-hitting Penumbra on every keystroke.
